correctness.rationale: The exact CE differential on 3n+2 generators is a Koszul complex for the commuting root operators E12,E13 on the exterior algebra of n copies of the standard GL3 module. The skew-Cauchy decomposition and dual Jacobi-Trudi determinant give all multiplicities. Highest- and lowest-weight uniqueness gives kernel and cokernel dimensions b-c+1 and a-b+1; Euler characteristic gives a-c+2 in the middle. Nomizu transfers all characteristic-zero ranks to rational nilmanifold cohomology. Independent cochain matrices over primes 3 and 101 match n=1,2,3 in all degrees; finite cases only diagnostics.

value.rationale: The family K_{2,n} is the natural first non-star complete-bipartite family, containing four-cycles. The result computes every rational Betti number in every dimension by O(n^3) explicit positive integer determinants, a substantial extension of known star/path families; it is neither a degree-three normalization nor an isolated finite table.
